title: Row and column of a cell
description: A grid has width columns and cells are numbered row by row: row 0 holds cells 0 to width-1, row 1 the next width cells, and row -1 holds cells -width to -1 (rows above row 0 have negative numbers). Return the position of cell as the text "row,col", where row is cell / width rounded down toward negative infinity and col is the column 0 to width-1. width is positive. For example cell -1 with width 4 is "-1,3".
notes: Experiment int_division: hidden tests use negative operands; the description states floor semantics (round toward negative infinity) in words. The ref.zehn is written with int.div_floor / int.div_trunc / int.rem_euclid so it is valid under int_ops=operators and int_ops=explicit.
